Your task is summarize the modifications made in the patch.
Your summary should consist of two parts, modifications in each file and their relationships.

From 0c630a66bf10991b0ef13d27c93d7545e692ef5b Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Pan Bian <bianpan2016@163.com>
Date: Tue, 19 Jan 2021 20:44:23 -0800
Subject: [PATCH] net: systemport: free dev before on error path

On the error path, it should goto the error handling label to free
allocated memory rather than directly return.

Fixes: 31bc72d97656 ("net: systemport: fetch and use clock resources")
Signed-off-by: Pan Bian <bianpan2016@163.com>
Acked-by: Florian Fainelli <f.fainelli@gmail.com>
Link: https://lore.kernel.org/r/20210120044423.1704-1-bianpan2016@163.com
Signed-off-by: Jakub Kicinski <kuba@kernel.org>

diff --git a/drivers/net/ethernet/broadcom/bcmsysport.c b/drivers/net/ethernet/broadcom/bcmsysport.c
index b1ae9eb8f247..0404aafd5ce5 100644
--- a/drivers/net/ethernet/broadcom/bcmsysport.c
+++ b/drivers/net/ethernet/broadcom/bcmsysport.c
@@ -2503,8 +2503,10 @@ static int bcm_sysport_probe(struct platform_device *pdev)
 	priv = netdev_priv(dev);
 
 	priv->clk = devm_clk_get_optional(&pdev->dev, "sw_sysport");
-	if (IS_ERR(priv->clk))
-		return PTR_ERR(priv->clk);
+	if (IS_ERR(priv->clk)) {
+		ret = PTR_ERR(priv->clk);
+		goto err_free_netdev;
+	}
 
 	/* Allocate number of TX rings */
 	priv->tx_rings = devm_kcalloc(&pdev->dev, txq,
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

**File: `drivers/net/ethernet/broadcom/bcmsysport.c`**
- The error handling for the clock resource acquisition was modified. Instead of returning an error code directly when `devm_clk_get_optional` fails, the code now assigns the error code to a variable `ret` and uses a `goto` statement to jump to an error handling label (`err_free_netdev`).
- This change ensures that the allocated network device (`dev`) is properly freed before exiting the function in case of an error.

### Relationships
- The modification improves the error handling logic in the `bcm_sysport_probe` function by ensuring that resources are cleaned up correctly on failure. This change is related to the previous commit identified by the fix tag, which introduced the clock resource fetching. The patch addresses a potential memory leak by ensuring that allocated resources are freed appropriately when an error occurs during the initialization process.
